title: The Last Choir Revisited
author: Juniper Montrose
blurb: Quentin Coldharbour, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
